services.desc: Proudly sponsored by Moose Jaw Co-op, this new exhibit highlights the history and living heritage of Indigenous Peoples in Moose Jaw and southern Saskatchewan through presentations of living objects, such as ceramics, projectile points, stone tools and beadwork! Presented in Recognition of the Royal Canadian Air Force’s Centennial Anniversary in 2024. April 1, 2024 marked 100 years of service for the Royal Canadian Air Force as a distinct military element.
